messages:
Jess: Hi team — first week! Quick runthrough: who do I ping for (1) staging GPU access, (2) VPN and key rotation, (3) getting added to inference on-call, and (4) badge/door access? Also, any owner lists I should bookmark? :wave:

Devon (eng-sre): Hey Jess — welcome! For on-call add & PD stuff ping me. SRE owns incident response for inference. For page order: inference-oncall -> platform -> runtime. PD contact: devops+pd@redwood.com

Ryan (eng-platform): Staging GPU access is handled by infra access requests. Open this form: https://redwood.internal/access-requests (select "staging-gpu"). Or run the internal slash: ```/access request --resource=staging-gpu --reason="onboarding"```

Casey (eng-infra): Badge/door = people-ops. File badge request here: https://people-ops.redwood/badge-request and include manager approval. VPN creds via Okta MFA — people-ops will trigger it.

Maria (product): For owner lists: we maintain a lightweight map in the handbook. Product-side owners for features live in that doc; ping me for product questions.

Alex (eng-ml): I own model-serving owner list (v1/v2). If you need model-level contacts or eval owners, DM me @alex. Docs: https://handbook.redwood/models/owners

hr-bot: Welcome Jess! Onboarding checklist: https://onboarding.redwood/checklist. Steps for keys, hardware, and compliance training are listed.

Jess: Thanks — helpful. For escalation: if hosted API latency spikes, who gets paged first (and what runbook)?

Devon (eng-sre): Page inference-oncall first. If no ack, PD escalates to eng-platform. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference-latency (see mitigations + quick rollback)

Ryan (eng-platform): On capacity issues tag: @eng-runtime and @eng-platform; for customer-impacting incidents also notify @support and the account team. If you want PD add sample (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST https://pd.internal/api/users -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"jess@redwood.com","role":"oncall"}'
```

Casey (eng-infra): Quick note: for Dedicated onboarding (customer GPU pools / capacity contracts) Solutions Eng + Support run that. @Sam-soleng handles scheduling.

Sam (solutions): Hi Jess, happy to set a 30-min kickoff to walk Dedicated onboarding & SSO. Ping me and I'll schedule.

Jess: Awesome, copying these links/contacts into my onboarding doc. Appreciate the quick responses! :raised_hands:
